svg.title: Just One More Moment
svg.desc: My Raspberry Pi 5 wiring: display power pins 2/6; button COM/NO pins 9/11; button LED pins 13/14; switch 1 pins 15/20; switch 2 pins 16/25; 12 NeoPixels DIN pin 19 GPIO10. The diode is in the 5 V supply with its cathode band toward the strip. NeoPixel power uses physical pin 4 through a MIC 1N4001 diode; pin 34 is the ground selected for this plan. SW01 is local AI or cloud AI plus camera; SW02 selects English or German. USB webcam and DSI display link included.

g.aria-label: Component views are not to scale.
I use the Adafruit supply-drop method.
D1 lowers the strip supply voltage.
This helps it read 3.3 V data as HIGH.
